rationale: The largest normalized residual test was performed iteratively. In the first iteration with all 5 measurements, the injection at bus b2 (inj_b2) had the largest normalized residual (10.11), which exceeded the threshold of 3.0. This measurement was flagged as bad data and removed. The state was re-estimated using the remaining 4 measurements. In the second iteration, the largest normalized residual was 0.562 (for inj_b3), which is below the threshold. The process terminated. The final corrected state is the result from the second iteration: theta_2 = -0.0400588... and theta_3 = -0.07.
